subject: MAP: Close cadence and compliance checkpoints (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA retention)
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@meadowbank.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@meadowbank.com, legal@meadowbank.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff and compliance checkpoints

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — MeadowBank is interested in moving toward a POC and then a limited production rollout, but our security and procurement teams need a clear mutual action plan so we can align internal calendar commitments. A few specific asks from my side:

- Can you share a MAP with milestone dates for SOC 2 evidence intake, SIG/CAIQ completion, and DPA finalization?
- We need a proposed data retention window for customer and production logs (field-level and full request logs) and any carveouts you recommend for fraud/AML investigations.
- Is there a single point of contact on your side for evidence uploads and to coordinate the SOC 2 evidence sprint?

We'd like to target a commercial close by the end of Q3 if responses look reasonable. Attaching a short internal checklist for your review.

Sara
Sara Lin
CTO, MeadowBank

Attachment: meadowbank-soc2-gap-analysis.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@meadowbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and compliance checkpoints

Sara — thanks, great next steps. I've put together a proposed MAP and timeline (attached) that aligns our security milestones with procurement gates. Summary highlights:

- Week 1 (evidence intake): SOC 2 readiness checklist + evidence portal access; Redwood to provide a scannable evidence index and upload template.
- Week 2–3: SIG/CAIQ: we will complete the majority of rows and mark the few open items that need third-party confirmation (subprocessors, EU data residency proofs).
- Week 3–4: DPA negotiation: redlines tracked — our legal (Neha) will lead and push for standard carveouts where necessary.
- Target: contract signed and operational dial-in by 2026-09-30 (end of Q3).

Retention proposal (initial):
- Production request logs: 365 days by default (configurable down to 90 days for EU-located accounts).
- Field-level PII derivatives (indexable tokens): 90 days default; extendable by contract for specific investigative needs.
- Fraud/AML carveout: preserve up to 5 years on hold when lawful investigation is active; retention only accessible to joint e-discovery workflow.

POC owner / evidence lead on our side: Karthik (cc'd) will be the day-to-day contact; Neha will handle legal/DPA redlines.

Attached: MAP-proposed-cadence-2026.pdf; draft-dpa-redline.docx (first pass). Please review and flag any hard constraints. If this timeline works, can we schedule a 30-minute alignment call Friday to lock dates?

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-proposed-cadence-2026.pdf, draft-dpa-redline.docx
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@meadowbank.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and compliance checkpoints — DPA & retention clarifications

Sara — looping in a couple of quick clarifications from Legal so we don't block procurement: 

1) EU retention defaults: Redwood can commit to a 90-day default for EU-region production logs and a 90-day field-level PII retention. If MeadowBank requires longer retention for regulatory reasons, we can add schedule language (Annex) per account.

2) Subprocessors / data flow: we'll provide an up-to-date subprocessor list and SOC-type attestations for the major cloud providers we use. For on-prem or air-gapped Private customers there are additional options (contact Marcus).

3) SIG / CAIQ rows: our security team will self-attest for all controls in scope; open rows will be marked as "requires customer confirmation" where the control depends on customer configuration. Expected SIG completion: within two weeks of evidence intake.

4) Draft redlines: attached doc highlights three main areas (liability cap carveouts for investigatory hold, EU residency SLA, and approved subprocessor notification window). We'd propose a 48–72 hour turnaround for each redline cycle during the MAP sprint to hit your Q3 close.

If that cadence is acceptable, we can circulate a versioned MAP and update HubSpot deal MB-2026-09 with the milestones.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-dpa-redline.docx
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@meadowbank.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@meadowbank.com, legal@meadowbank.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and compliance checkpoints — DPA & retention clarifications

Thanks — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few quick notes:

- 90-day default for EU logs is fine; we'll confirm if any regulated lines of business require an Annex with longer retention.
- The fraud/AML investigative hold approach sounds acceptable; please add a short operational note in the MAP about the process (who to contact, SLA for evidence requests).
- We'll review the DPA redlines and aim to return comments within 48 hours per your proposed cadence. Procurement will coordinate the DocuSign milestone and lock the signature owners.

Let's take the 30-min call Friday at 10:00 AM PT to approve the MAP milestones and schedule the evidence intake session. I've asked procurement to send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Sara
Sara Lin
CTO, MeadowBank
